item.title: Is a Working Holiday Really for Me?
item.description: Presents a neutral decision-making framework to assess the pros and cons of a Working Holiday (WH). It supports individuals in making rational choices suited to their personal circumstances through three questions: clarifying goals, considering alternatives, and calculating all costs, including opportunity costs.

item.title: Do Android Police Dream of Electric Black People?
item.description: As AI becomes an indispensable part of daily life, this article examines the risks of delegating human judgment to algorithms. Drawing parallels to the Sibyl System, the author highlights how AI, as a statistical prediction engine, often replicates historical biases found in its training data. While acknowledging the efficiency of these tools, the post emphasizes the importance of understanding AI's limitations and maintaining a critical perspective to prevent technology from entrenching social prejudices.
